simple.meaning: מִפְשָׂעָה (miphsâʻâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a stride , i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H4667. miphsaah מִפְשָׂעָה noun feminine stepping-region of body, hip or buttock ; ׳עַדהַֿמּ 1Chr 19:4 (= שְׁתוֺתיהֶם || 2Sam 10:4 ).

occurrences.englishText: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
